goal: Let the governed review runner carry the brief and head-bound VERDICT instruction to ai-deepseek-agent as its positional message, instead of refusing it or forwarding an unsupported --prompt-file flag. Also re-point two truth-audit disposition entries whose call sites only moved (same line hash, same disposition), which left main's Tools offline tests red.
prohibited_actions: Do not weaken the stale-head check or the missing-brief refusal.
Do not change behavior for any wrapper other than ai-deepseek-agent.
Do not touch any migration, workflow, database object, or live row.
Do not change any disposition or reason in the truth-audit catalogues.
assumptions: Disclosed: generation 1 was published after implementation commit 246c050; generation 2 widens scope to two disposition catalogues after main's truth audit was found red and the re-point was prepared locally. No disposition or reason text changes; only site and semantic_key move to the rediscovered site with the identical line_sha256.
stop_conditions: Stop on any gate refusal rather than weakening the gate.
Stop if the change needs a file outside allowed_paths.
